source_contract.api_version: Wikidata Query Service public SPARQL 1.1 endpoint as observed at execution; no provider snapshot or revision ID is exposed
source_contract.data_version: mutable live WDQS RDF dataset; exact response Date headers, retrieval timestamps, bytes, and SHA-256 receipts define the observed version
source_contract.retry_rule: No retry inside this census. Any transport, HTTP, content-type, JSON, schema, ordering, or completeness failure is terminal and requires a new reviewed census ID.
source_contract.pagination_rule: One exact unpaginated query per painter. Success requires one HTTP 200 SPARQL JSON result with no duplicate binding and strict ascending item-QID/filename order. This route is incomplete if the public service cannot return any complete painter query within its documented 60-second runtime limit.
source_contract.candidate_rule: Exact creator P170, exact painting P31=Q3305213, and P18 image. P186 is intentionally absent and oil-on-canvas is deferred to an authority record.
source_contract.canonicalization_rule: Preserve provider item and image URIs; validate strict URI syntax; decode the Special:FilePath suffix once with UTF-8 percent-decoding; replace underscores with spaces; preserve case; and sort candidates by painter ID, item QID string, then filename string. No title, creator, material, or work identity normalization occurs.
source_contract.duplicate_rule: Reject duplicate item-image bindings within a painter response and reject duplicate creator-item-filename rows across responses. Do not deduplicate physical works at this discovery stage.
source_contract.raw_response_rule: Store every exact response body once in SHA-256 content-addressed storage and bind status, final URL, selected headers, byte count, retrieval timestamp, body path, and digest in the append-only event ledger.
source_contract.rights_and_media_rule: Not requested and not inferred in this discovery route. Rights, geometry, decode, authority, capture ancestry, and image delivery are separate later gates.
source_contract.terminal_condition: All four frozen painter queries return parser-complete HTTP 200 results; otherwise the whole route is terminally incomplete without fallback or top-up.

query_template: SELECT DISTINCT ?item ?image WHERE { ?item wdt:P170 wd:{creator_qid}; wdt:P31 wd:Q3305213; wdt:P18 ?image. } ORDER BY STR(?item) STR(?image)
